referee_caveats_inferred: Distance uncertainty (~36%) dominates mass and density errors and propagates into Jeans comparisons.
Uniform 200 K temperature is assumed though temperature varies; conclusions on thermal inhibition depend on this choice.
Optical depth at 1.3 mm (spectral index ~2) may bias masses low.
Small number statistics (29 fragments) for MSDC and breaks; bin choice could shift breaks.
Low-res 1.3 mm data from different epoch and calibration, flux-scale consistency not discussed.
